name: Director's Gold Medal
eligibility: Top academic performance across all disciplines, Outstanding all-round achievement.

name: Director's Silver Medal
eligibility: Highest CPI in the respective branch/discipline.
description: The Director's Silver Medal is awarded to the student securing the highest academic standing (CPI) in their respective B.Tech or M.Tech discipline among the graduating class.

name: Convocation Medals
eligibility: Excellence in specific technical, cultural, or sports domains.
description: The Proficiency Medal is bestowed upon students demonstrating exceptional proficiency and dedication in specific institute-level clubs, societies, or domains including technical, cultural, and sports.
